Most advice on this topic is vague. This guide is a field note: what to change on your site this week so you stand out for the right reasons.

The default path (Drive folders, Canva PDFs, unfinished Notion pages) makes you look busy — not hire-ready.

This guide is for first-time portfolio builders who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

The fastest way to look unique is to publish something true — not to wait for a perfect custom build.

Do this next

  1. Claim your handle today
  2. Add three real projects (or two + one strong case study)
  3. Publish, then improve weekly

One composition, one job

Each section should do one thing: introduce you, prove a project, or invite contact. When sections compete, nothing lands.

How a website helps you stand out

The fastest way to look unique is to publish something true — not to wait for a perfect custom build.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.com, create on dash.mybexo.com, share on yourname.atbexo.com. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • Claim your handle today
  • Add three real projects (or two + one strong case study)
  • Publish, then improve weekly

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
